definition: mind, feeling and body, and how far apart mine sit

settled:
Most people run the three as one, so seamlessly it never reads as three things. Mine come apart far enough that I am nearly two people: one all concept, and one feeling and body together.

What pulled them apart is having no pictures. The thinking channel runs offline from the feeling one.

Eighty percent map, ten percent feeling, ten percent body.

So my war is mind against body, with what feeling I can reach taking the body's side. Feeling has not the wattage to be a third party of its own. The head-against-heart story slides past me, and so does most music built on it.

It is not a wall. Enough physical load floods across into the thinking half.

Which means the thinking half is no protected witness looking on while the body suffers. Through the twenty years, the wish not to exist lived in the conceptual half rather than the other one.

The smallest part, the will to live, is what carried me through the worst years.
